name: Roon's Kodo Horn
summary: Roon’s Kodo Horn is a gift from a Tauren hunter in Desolace. It carries an invitation to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. in Stranglethorn, recalling the friendship between Roon and his father.

sections.title: A Hunter's Gift
sections.body: Hemet Nesingwary Jr. hunts in Stranglethorn, north of Grom'gol Base Camp. His father once hunted beside Roon Wildmane in Desolace, and the two set aside the enmity between their peoples. Roon gives you his kodo horn to carry to the younger Nesingwary. The gift bears a welcome from an old hunting companion.

faq.answer: Roon Wildmane is a Tauren hunter from Desolace who once hunted alongside Hemet Nesingwary.

faq.q: Why give Hemet Jr. the horn?
faq.answer: Roon sends the horn as a gift and a welcome to Hemet Nesingwary Jr., his old companion's son.

faq.q: Where can I find Hemet Jr.?
faq.answer: Hemet Nesingwary Jr. is in Stranglethorn, north of Grom'gol Base Camp.
Hemet was the dwarf who hunted great beasts with Roon Wildmane in Desolace.

faq.q: What does the horn mean to Roon?
faq.answer: The horn is Roon's gift to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. and carries Roon's welcome.

faq.q: Did Roon and Hemet get along?
faq.answer: Yes. Roon says he and Hemet hunted together for many days and forgot the enmity between their peoples.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you carry a gift that recalls Hemet's friendship with Roon Wildmane, despite the enmity between their peoples.
As a Tauren, you may know the horn as Roon Wildmane's gift and welcome to Hemet Nesingwary Jr.
